name: koi-pond
description: A braille koi pond across the band above the prompt: koi drift and fishtail while you type, dart while Claude works, settle to the bottom as the context window fills, and a ripple (with a bloop) marks each finished turn.

sound.description: Play a soft bloop when a turn finishes.
sound.title: Bloop on finished turns

rows.title: Pond height (rows)

fish.title: Koi drawing

water.title: Water
